results.title: East China refunds: public-safe summary for interns
results.content: Refunds in East China rose noticeably in Q3, mostly from September, while other regions stayed flat (b-101). Customers there mainly reported checkout payment problems, such as being charged twice or charged after a failed payment, and the cause is still under investigation, so do not state it as confirmed (b-207; b-318 is unverified and links a recent app payment change to a possible double charge, with the refund impact unconfirmed). Customers can request a refund within 30 days from the Orders page, and it returns to the original payment method in 5-7 business days (b-208). Internal figures and ticket statistics are deliberately left out.
results.author: finance
